text: せかい　じゅうを　たび　してきたが　ねむって　ばかりの　あいつを　みつけたときは　ほんとに　あきれた　たしか…！

structure.jp: せかい　じゅうを　たび　してきたが
structure.en: I've traveled all over the world, but

structure.jp: ねむって　ばかりの　あいつを　みつけたときは
structure.en: when I found that one that does nothing but sleep

structure.jp: ほんとに　あきれた

patterns.name: 〜てばかり
patterns.explanation: ばかり after a て-form says someone does only that one thing all the time. ねむって　ばかりの　あいつ = 'that one that does nothing but sleep'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says the action has been going on from the past up to now. たび　してきた = 'I have been traveling up to now'.

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: とき after a verb means 'when' that thing happened. あいつを　みつけたときは = 'when I found that one'.
